QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] In the Thick of War
QuestInfo.0: Just as the Graviton Flame was about to strike the final blow for humanity, #o9601836# appeared and turned the tide. Now, humanity's ultimate weapon lies in ruin.
QuestInfo.1: Shibuya, in 2102, is embroiled in the thick of war. Just as the Graviton Flame was about to strike the final blow for humanity, #o9601836# appeared and turned the tide. Now, humanity's ultimate weapon lies in ruin. The pilot of the Graviton Flame - #p9401522#, whom you helped in the park in 2095 - asks that you do what he couldn't, and defeat #o9601836#.
QuestInfo.2: You fought off #o9601836#. During the fight, you saw that he had his own Mastercore.
